assertion.statement: For the actual A/K, W0=Res_K/Q A is an abelian variety of dimension2[K:Q], and after Qbar base change is the product of the conjugate surfaces with Galois transporting the factors.
assertion.objects: The actual projective abelian surface A/K and finite number field K.
assertion.hypotheses: A/K is the surface from the normalized full-three cover; K/Q is finite and hence separable.
assertion.quantifiers: Every such variety and finite separable extension.
assertion.parameter_range: This original K and A; no replacement family.
assertion.uniformity: Formation is compatible with base change.
assertion.normalizations: The factors correspond to field embeddings.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The endomorphism-lattice field, Tate faithfulness and ramification conclusions remain separate.
assertion.limit_order: Construct the restriction and product decomposition before deriving the induced Tate representation and inertia action.

use.reason: Apply the accepted finite-separable Weil restriction theorem to the projective surface. Base change to Qbar gives the product indexed by embeddings; functoriality transports factors under Galois. The subsequent Tate direct sum and inertia argument is the explicit local application in main1214–1223.
use.shared_contract_justification: Both occurrences concern the same W0, K and A: initial construction and its later conjugate-product realization.

supplier.statement: Weil restriction of an abelian variety through a finite separable extension exists and becomes the product of its conjugates after a splitting extension.

publication.title: On the arithmetic of abelian varieties
publication.corrections: Finite separability and projectivity retained; exact source review reused.
